sources.title: Conventional Comments (standard)
usage: `references/conventional-comments.md`: label list, the `label (decoration): subject` format, the blocking / non-blocking / if-minor decorations, and the machine-parseable shape

sources.title: Conventional comments: practitioner guides
usage: corroborating the decoration semantics and the "label removes ambiguity" rationale

sources.title: Internal review practice (applied)
sources.provenance: Repository-original review conventions distilled from maintained team practice
usage: the summary-plus-inline structure, cross-linking instead of ordinal references, verify-before-assert (read the branch, confirm component / API signatures via the relevant design-system or library skill before suggesting a fix), and the house writing style (no em-dash / semicolon / ellipsis in review prose) mined from a real Bitbucket PR review

the platform-independent findings pipeline: `references/findings-schema.md` (canonical inline findings shape, new-file hunk anchoring), `references/review-analyze.md` (diff → findings, effort dial, prior-findings comparison), `references/review-refine.md` (per-finding operations, label discipline). Distilled from maintained review commands; host delivery is a separate Publish or Execute operation

sources.title: Guide-level synthesis
sources.provenance: Repository-original integration of the source blocks above; these references combine multiple inputs or maintained conventions rather than one exclusive upstream

notes.title: Refresh Workflow
notes.text:
1. Re-check the Conventional Comments GitLab repository for any change to the label set or decorations
2. Fold recurring review-craft lessons (from session lessons, through `authoring-skills`) into the references
3. Bump **Last reviewed** above
